BATTLE_LESSONS.title: The real battle screen
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: This practice uses the real dice, heroes, tower map, Focus system, and combat controls. Training never charges Fate and does not change live war results.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Fate and Focus are different
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Fate is persistent soft currency outside combat. Focus is the resource you spend inside the match for roll multipliers and ALL-IN. Wars and raids are free to enter.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Roll an attack
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap ROLL. This training result is scripted to land three swords so you can see a triple attack and how combat pressure begins.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Tower control wins the map
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Damage and pressure at a tower help your guild take or defend it. Rotate when another lane matters more.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Build your shields
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap ROLL for three shields. Shields absorb damage before health and can keep you standing during an enemy push.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Read enemy pressure
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Enemy telegraphs and Focus indicators show where danger is building. Defend, rotate, or counterattack before the push lands.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Gain Focus
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Roll the Focus result. During battle these resource faces refill Focus so you can afford stronger multipliers without spending Fate.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Choose a multiplier
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap the multiplier once to increase it. Higher multipliers spend more Focus and amplify the roll.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Try a multiplied attack
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap ROLL at ×2. The same triple now creates a larger swing while consuming more Focus.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: ALL-IN is a commitment
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: With enough Focus, cycling beyond normal multipliers reaches ALL-IN. It commits your available Focus to one major roll.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Critical attacks
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap ROLL for critical symbols. Critical results can trigger a close-up skill sequence and produce a much stronger hit.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Triples charge SPELL
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Triples charge SPELL. Barrage is a free attack, Bulwark protects a tower and shields allies, War Horn starts a free Rally, and Arcane Surge gives +4 Focus plus a 10-second power boost.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Guild gifts
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap ROLL for gifts, then choose a guildmate. Stored damage can be saved and activated later by the recipient.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Choose the bonus recipient
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap the glowing card. Its displayed value already includes the special bonus.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Your trainer sent you an attack
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Captain Rowan has given you a stored 500-damage gift. Tap the sword at the top of the battlefield to see saved attacks.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Use the saved attack
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Choose the 500-damage attack. Your hero attacks immediately without a dice roll or Focus cost. Enemy shields can still absorb it.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Use your ultimate
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Your training ultimate is fully charged. Tap it now. In a live match, battle actions refill the ultimate meter.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Open the war map
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap Map. Fatebound has three strategic lanes: Outposts, Camp, and Courtyard.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Choose the next tower
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap a tower to enter its battlefield. Look at where your guild is winning or losing before choosing.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Call your guild
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap Rally to ask teammates to focus this tower. Use it where coordinated pressure can change the match.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Crowns and the final push
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tower control shapes crowns. Triples charge SPELL. The last part of the 5-minute clock is where rotations matter most.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Return home in training
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap Home. Training lets you explore menus because it is not a real match. A live 5-minute battle locks these menus until the result.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Review your hero
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap Hero to inspect attack power, critical attack, equipment, upgrades, and your ultimate.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Equipment and upgrades
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Your Hero page shows character abilities and your armory. Equipment can be changed here and forging uses gold and weapon shards.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Your guild
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap Guild. This page shows your guild’s score, messages, and teammates.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Explore the guild page
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: The roster shows each member’s location and damage contribution. Guild messages help coordinate pushes.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Friends and gifts
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap Friends. You can send help to a guildmate here. Stored damage gifts are used from the sword button on the battlefield.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Your gifts stay saved
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: You do not have to spend a damage gift immediately. Keep it for an important tower or the final push.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Fate and the shop
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap Shop. I’ve added 500 practice gold to demonstrate a purchase. Regular Fate sales are paused; your real gold and Fate are unchanged by this lesson.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Buy a Fate flask
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap the 300-practice-gold button for +10 stored Fate. This is a demonstration in a temporary save, not a live Shop purchase. Battle multipliers spend Focus instead.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Check your Fate balance
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Your Fate increased by 10 and your practice gold decreased by 300. Fate persists outside battle; Focus is separate and resets each match.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Back to your home hub
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Tap Home. From here you can access quests, Hero, Guild, Friends, Shop, training, and battle.

BATTLE_LESSONS.title: Ready for a real 5-minute battle
BATTLE_LESSONS.text: Training is complete. In a real match, manage Focus, rotate lanes, charge SPELL, use Rally and your ultimate, and finish with the stronger crown position.
